name: Rude Awakening
summary: Newly awakened Forsaken leave Deathknell's crypts and face an unfamiliar life. Freed from the Lich King's grip, you are sent down the hill, away from the incinerators, to learn what comes next from Shadow Priest Sarvis.

sections.title: A Grave Beginning
sections.body: In Deathknell's crypt, you wake to undeath among damp stone and cold air. Undertaker Mordo watches the newly buried, sorting those who regain free will from those bound for the burning pits. Many rise confused, surrounded by rot and stone. By chance, they have slipped the Scourge's grasp.

sections.title: Breaking the Grip of the Frozen Throne
sections.body: Before you reach the chapel, you face a grim truth: once, you were a mindless tool of the Lich King. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner broke that psychic enslavement, freeing remnants of your former humanity to reclaim independent thought. You leave the tomb and head down into Deathknell, beginning life in a world where the living and the Scourge alike see you as an abomination to be destroyed.

faq.q: Why was I in a crypt?
faq.answer: You died during the Third War from plague or violence, then were buried in Tirisfal Glades. In Deathknell, the newly risen are watched to see whether they regain their minds or sink into mindless rot.

Undertaker Mordo cares for Deathknell's crypt. He watches the newly awakened and sends those who keep their sanity to the town chapel. Those who fail to awaken with their minds intact are disposed of.

faq.q: Why did Mordo mention throwing people into the fire?
faq.answer: Not every corpse raised from the grave regains free will or steady thoughts. Those who awaken mad or purely feral cannot join Forsaken society. They are destroyed and burned to prevent rampages.

faq.q: Who freed me from the Lich King?
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, known as the Banshee Queen, broke free of the Lich King's psychic domination as his power waned. She gathered other free-willed undead beneath her banner and founded the Forsaken to fight their former master and hostile living remnants.

faq.q: Where is Shadow Priest Sarvis located?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Sarvis is inside the damaged chapel at the base of the hill in Deathknell. Leave the crypt and follow the cobblestone path downhill to the chapel entrance.

faq.q: Who are the Forsaken fighting against?
faq.answer: The Forsaken fight a two-front war for survival. They face the Scourge, which seeks to reclaim or destroy them, and human zealots and surviving settlements that see no difference between them and mindless monsters.

angles.text: As an Undead, you have shed the Scourge's shackles and begin a spiteful, free life among the Forsaken.
As a Priest, you meet the Forsaken priesthood through Shadow Priest Sarvis. After undeath, spiritual devotion takes on new meaning.
As a member of the Horde, you enter a fragile alliance formed from sheer necessity against mutual extinction.
